Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap from discovery:
- Primary use case: reduce time-to-resolution for customer support using retrieval-augmented generation for KB + ticket summarization.
- Success metrics: 30–40% reduction in handle time; 20% fewer escalations to L2 in pilot.
- Expected pilot scope: 5 agents, ~200k tokens/month; goal to expand after Q1 results.

Stakeholder map (from the call / to confirm):
- Champion: Alice Smith (you) — product/ops lead, driving internal adoption
- Economic buyer: Sam Patel — Head of Digital Channels (decision on budget)
- Security reviewer: InfoSec (TBD individual) — will require SOC2 + data flow doc
- Procurement: Procurement Team (handles SOW/PO and legal terms)

Requests / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and the primary InfoSec reviewer (name/email)?
2) Procurement timeline? You mentioned "end of November" as a target for PO — confirm if that still stands.
3) I’ve attached a short ROI outline that you can use with Sam and execs — happy to tailor.
4) Would you like a 30-minute internal enablement session for your champions next week with talk tracks and Q&A? We can include Rachel (CS) and Neha (solutions).

Attachments: Finovate-MAPL-ROI-Outline.pdf (one-pager), Redwood-Champion-Talk-Tracks.pdf (draft)

If you confirm stakeholders I’ll send a short enablement cadence doc and proposed calendar times.

Thanks —

Rachel / Neha — forwarding Alice’s confirmation. Core asks from Finovate: exec ROI slide, security artifacts (data flow, retention, KMS), and a short procurement checklist.

Below are proposed talk tracks / enablement agenda we can run in a 30-min session for Alice + Sam + Rajesh:
1) 3-min exec opener (Alice): problem statement + desired business outcomes (H4)
2) 7-min economic case (Marissa): pilot costs, expected time-to-payback, 12-month ARR impact — key numbers we need: pilot price (I’ll propose $Xk), estimated savings from HT reduction (we need CS to validate assumptions)
3) 10-min technical + security (Neha): data flow, retention policy, encryption, SOC2 alignment, sample artifact pack to share with Rajesh
4) 5-min procurement path (Rachel): SOW highlights, procurement timeline, PO process, typical redlines and how we handle them
5) 5-min Q&A / next steps / calendar + action items

Action items (owned):
- Marissa: produce 1-slide exec ROI + draft pilot pricing and send by EOD 10/30. Attach SOW template. (attach: SOW-template.docx)
- Neha: draft data flow diagram + retention/KMS summary by 11/02.
- Rachel: procurement checklist + list of typical contract exceptions we can pre-authorize by 11/02.

Proposed enablement times (ET): Wed 11/03 10:00–10:30 or Thu 11/04 9:00–9:30. Alice prefer morning ET; I can own scheduling once you confirm.

Marissa
